name: Hash Kit
summary: SHA-256, base64 and hex encode a string.
description: Adds a Use permission and three commands: sha256, base64 and hex. A member who holds the permission can transform a string with any of the three.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Use hash/encode tools
permissions.description: Run sha256, base64 or hex on a string.

extension_points.name: sha256
extension_points.description: Return the SHA-256 hex digest of the given string.
